Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

hidden.

message across all prompt types (dialoguer and custom yes/no),
and ensures the terminal cursor is always restored when the
custom yes/no prompt encounters an error.
EOF
)"

Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

hidden.

message across all prompt types (dialoguer and custom yes/no),
and ensures the terminal cursor is always restored when the
custom yes/no prompt encounters an error.
EOF
)"

Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D (EOF) during an interactive prompt caused an
unhandled UnexpectedEof IO error to propagate, crashing the

hidden.

This converts EOF errors into a friendlier "Interrupted (EOF)"
message across all prompt types (dialoguer and custom yes/no),
and ensures the terminal cursor is always restored when the
custom yes/no prompt encounters an error.
EOF

Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

custom yes/no prompt encounters an error.
EOF

Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D (EOF) during an interactive prompt caused an
unhandled UnexpectedEof IO error to propagate, crashing the
program with a raw error message and leaving the terminal cursor
hidden.

This converts EOF errors into a friendlier "Interrupted (EOF)"
message across all prompt types (dialoguer and custom yes/no),
and ensures the terminal cursor is always restored when the
custom yes/no prompt encounters an error.
EOF
)"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Handle Ctrl+D gracefully in interactive prompts

Pressing Ctrl+D (EOF) during an interactive prompt caused an
unhandled UnexpectedEof IO error to propagate, crashing the
program with a raw error message and leaving the terminal cursor
hidden.

This converts EOF errors into a friendlier "Interrupted (EOF)"
message across all prompt types (dialoguer and custom yes/no),
and ensures the terminal cursor is always restored when the
custom yes/no prompt encounters an error.
EOF
)"
